items.title: 4iG and SpaceX Plan Starlink Mobile Rollout Across Hungary and Western Balkans
items.summary: 4iG and SpaceX plan direct-to-device Starlink services across four European markets, alongside secured government communications, but national spectrum approvals and key details of the proposed sovereign infrastructure remain unresolved.

items.title: Nokia to sell private 5G ECE unit to Aurelius
items.summary: Nokia is selling its Enterprise Campus Edge (ECE) private 5G wireless business to private equity firm Aurelius. Terms were not disclosed.

items.title: SpaceX’s mobile moonshot gets real with 800 MHz spectrum grab
items.summary: SpaceX’s 800 MHz grab puts the U.S. mobile industry on notice: Elon’s coming for you.

items.title: Orange, Equitix and MDM plan subsea cable route linking Ireland and Europe
items.summary: The direct high-capacity, open-access and scalable connection will run between Ireland, France, Spain and Portugal, expanding connectivity and offering new commercial opportunities.

items.title: Opensignal map shows D2D’s reach – and limits
items.summary: Opensignal’s new map shows direct-to-device (D2D) satellite use expanding worldwide and overwhelmingly powered by Starlink, but still limited in reach.

items.title: Opinion: America is closing broadband gaps. Where is the bigger plan?
items.summary: The hard question is whether progress on connectivity will deliver the coordinated infrastructure needed for its next industrial economy.

items.title: Nokia launches flexible 50G/25G/10GPON for AI-ready fiber broadband
items.summary: The solution enables operators to adapt their existing fiber networks as these demands grow.

items.title: Kinetic partners with STL Optical Connectivity for fiber supply chain, expansion
items.summary: The partnership strengthens Kinetic’s access to international supply chain resources and more to support the company’s U.S. fiber build program.

items.title: gFiber scores early access to Qualcomm chips for new 20 Gig Wi-Fi 8 router
items.summary: gFiber’s new gateway will embed Qualcomm’s penta-core CPU, dedicated NPU, and an open agentic AI framework.

items.title: NVIDIA and Cisco intro pluggable optics form factor for AI factories
items.summary: NVIDIA and Cisco are working with TE Connectivity and Amphenol to build a multi-source hardware ecosystem around USFP.

items.title: Nvidia’s SVP of networking explains the 5 types of networks needed for AI factories
items.summary: AI workloads require multiple GPUs, and these GPUs must be networked together. But there are four other kinds of networks also used in AI data centers.

items.title: AT&T sells Mexico wireless biz to Grupo Televisa and Fintech Holdings for $2B
items.summary: AT&T Mexico grew the postpaid market segment in 2026, which meant a higher-valued business in the run-up to a sale but BNP Parabas says the result is still a net loss.

items.title: Cisco and Nvidia develop new pluggable optic module for AI data centers
items.summary: Cisco has gotten feedback from its customers that what they really want is something that's like the old thing, but in the next generation.
